
---
title: "Redirecting..."
format:
  html:
    minimal: true
---

<script>
  // Get the current broken path requested by the user
  var currentPath = window.location.pathname;
  
  // Check if it belongs to the old folder structure
  if (currentPath.startsWith('/QMCSoftware')) {
    // Strip out the old directory name
    var remainingPath = currentPath.replace(/^\/QMCSoftware/, '');
    
    // Build the correct destination URL while keeping queries and hashes
    var newURL = "https://qmcsoftware.org/qmcpy" + remainingPath + window.location.search + window.location.hash;
    
    // Push the user to the correct page immediately
    window.location.replace(newURL);
  } else {
    // Normal 404 text if they typed a completely unrelated broken link
    document.write('<h1>Page Not Found</h1><p>Go back to <a href="https://qmcsoftware.org/qmcpy/">QMCPy Home</a>.</p>');
  }
</script>
